Riding the AI enthusiasm from the Anthropic IPO debut as the Nasdaq jumps nearly 2%.

summary: Stocks are bouncing this morning, led by tech, as the Anthropic IPO debut fuels fresh AI enthusiasm. The Nasdaq is up nearly 2% and the VIX is dropping sharply as nerves ease after Nvidia's earnings failed to soothe investors yesterday.
